mapper.select: select p.id as `id`, p.material_code as `materialCode`, p.principal_name as `principalName`, p.maintence_style as `maintenceStyle`, p.stack_id as `stackId`, p.stage_id as `stageId`, p.is_end as `isEnd`, s.site_name as `stackName`, s.name_cn as `stackNameCn`, s.area_id as `areaId`, s.pid_route as `pidRoute`, date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as `dbNow` from tb_maintain_plan p left join tb_stack s on s.id = p.stack_id where p.id = #{id}

select t.id as `stageId`, t.phases as `phases`, t.maintain_days as `maintainDays`, date_format(t.aftercare_date_start, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as `startTime`, date_format(t.aftercare_date_end, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as `endTime`, ifnull(t.is_change, '0') as `isChange`, date_format(t.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as `createdTime`, date_format(t.updated_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as `updatedTime`, t.content as `content` from tb_maintain_plan_stage t where t.maintain_plan_id = #{id} order by t.id

select e.id as `id`, e.maintain_plan_id as `maintainPlanId`, e.maintain_result as `maintainResult`, ifnull(e.core_temp_all_early_time, 0) as `coreTempAllEarlyTime`, ifnull(e.core_temp_max_early_time, 0) as `coreTempMaxEarlyTime`, ifnull(e.oxygen_all_early_time, 0) as `oxygenAllEarlyTime`, ifnull(e.oxygen_max_early_time, 0) as `oxygenMaxEarlyTime`, ifnull(e.temp_all_early_time, 0) as `tempAllEarlyTime`, ifnull(e.temp_max_early_time, 0) as `tempMaxEarlyTime`, ifnull(e.humidity_all_early_time, 0) as `humidityAllEarlyTime`, ifnull(e.humidity_max_early_time, 0) as `humidityMaxEarlyTime` from tb_maintain_early_time e where e.maintain_plan_id = #{id} order by e.id desc limit 1
